editorial:
If you love Halloween and scary movies, Haunt is a fun pick for a spooky night in. The story follows a group of friends who stumble upon an extreme haunted house on Halloween night. At first, it feels like a normal thrill ride, but things quickly turn dark and dangerous. The setting is creepy, the scares come fast, and the movie keeps you guessing about who will make it out alive. It is the kind of horror that does not waste time, pulling you in right away and never letting go.

The acting is solid, especially from the main cast who sell the fear and panic well. The pacing is quick, with plenty of tense moments and clever traps that keep you on edge. On the downside, some characters feel a bit thin, and a few scares are predictable. Still, if you enjoy haunted house horror with real danger, this one delivers.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the surviving friends manage to fight back against the masked killers running the haunted house. They discover the attraction is a real murder trap, not just a show. After a brutal showdown, the last survivor escapes and makes it out alive. The twist comes when the police arrive and the survivor is taken away, but the killers' masks are left behind, hinting the nightmare could happen again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves haunted house horror and Halloween thrillers.
